SUMMARY 
Wiwin Widiawati (2024) thesis title "The Influence of Regional Original 
Income (PAD) and General Allocation Funds (DAU) on Regional Expenditures 
(Study of Regencies/Cities in Central Java)". Accounting Study Program, Faculty 
of Social, Economics and Humanities, Nahdlatul Ulama University Purwokerto. 
In order to implement decentralization, the central government allocates 
transfer funds sourced from the APBN, one of which is the General Allocation 
Fund. Apart from that, regional governments have their own funding sources in the 
form of Regional Original Income (PAD), financing and other legitimate income. 
The policy on the use of these funds is left entirely to the regions. 
This research aims to obtain a proven explanation regarding the Influence 
of Original Regional Income and General Allocation Funds on Regency/City 
Regional Expenditures in Central Java in 2020-2023. The subject of this research 
is the Regency/City Government in Central Java. The objects of this research are 
Regional Original Income (PAD), General Allocation Funds (DAU), and 
District/City Regional Expenditures in Central Java. The type of data collected is 
quantitative data sourced from Budget Realization Reports and documents. The 
analytical method used in this research is the multiple linear regression test. 
The results of this research show that Regional Original Income (PAD) and 
General Allocation Funds partially have a significant effect on Regional 
Expenditures in Regencies/Cities in Central Java. Then Regional Original Income 
(PAD) and General Allocation Funds (DAU) simultaneously have a significant 
influence on Regency/City Regional Expenditures in Central Java. It is hoped that 
the government will continue to increase regional revenue sources for 
districts/cities in Central Java to create regional independence, apart from that the 
management of the General Allocation Fund must be right on target. 
Keywords: Original Regional Income, General Allocation Funds, and Regional 
Expenditures
